intro: Across 36 articles spanning 12 April to 12 September 2026, ZCyberNews tracked credential-theft activity tied to AccountDumpling, APT41, and Bluekit. Coverage cites CVE-2021-47928 (CVSS 8.2), CVE-2025-29927, CVE-2025-48703, CVE-2025-55182, and CVE-2025-9501. The severity mix comprises 27 high, 6 critical, 1 medium, and 1 informational item. Affected sectors include technology, software development, cloud services, financial services, and social media. Reporting spans Global, Europe, North america, Bangladesh, and Florida.
